clips.text: Do not live out of the mind, otherwise you will always lag behind, because life never waits for you and your so-called mind.
That is why the mind always feels as if something is missing - because it is missing life itself - and always!
Once a master said to his disciples: If you utter a word - thirty blows of my stick for you.
But if you utter no words just the same, thirty blows of my stick Now - speak, speak!
One disciple came forward and when he was about to bow before the master he was struck.
The disciple protested: I have not uttered a single word nor did you allow me not to utter.
The master laughed and said If I wait for you and your speech or your silence, it is too late, and life cannot wait!
